1. Wake Up the Lock

Please read our listing thoroughly to find answers to Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs).

The space
Most of the house has been newly renovated and is presented to a beautiful standard.

Located in close proximity to the Belconnen town centre, it is also close to Canberra University, GIO Stadium, and 15 minutes to the city centre.

BEDROOM:
House has 4 bedrooms with professionally cleaned and pressed linen. Also, the bedrooms have plenty of wardrobe space for your luggage.

Up to eight people can be accommodated very comfortably in the forth bedrooms -
Master bedroom - King bed
Bedroom 2 - two single beds
Bedroom 3 - queen bed
Bedroom 4 - queen bed
Bedroom 5 - queen bed; located at the external extension to the main house and is accessed externally. Note that this bedroom's heater is not working at the moment but we're working on getting it fixed.

BATHROOM:
There are two bathrooms plus a separate toilet, including the large, stunning, newly renovated ensuite off the master bedroom. We provide bath towels, shampoo, conditioner, toilet paper, and body wash. Toilets also electronic bidet (Japanese style - cleaning rinse option) with control panel.

LIVING ROOM:
There are two separate living areas providing plenty of space. Both provide large lounge suites and large 65" Smart TVs. It also has access to local channels. Note that we don't provide Netflix, YouTube and other online streaming platforms subscriptions so you will have to use your own account. There's also MP3 System in the lounge.

The rumpus room has a gorgeous sunny aspect looking out to the rear yard and receives an abundance of warmth and sunlight.

KITCHEN AND DINING ROOM:
The kitchen is brand new and a glorious space to cook up a storm. Our guests will have use of the beautifully appointed and fully stocked kitchen including:
- large fridge/freezer
- induction cooktop
- crockery and cutlery
- dishwasher
- microwave

We stock a simple selection of food for breakfast such as milk and tea. Guests will need to purchase food items for longer stays.

There are two dining areas and a study nook with a desk

HEATING AND COOLING:
The house stays beautifully warm through the very effective ducted gas heating. In addition, the tiled floors through the main house and the ensuite bathroom have under-tile heating.

The back rumpus room and the bedroom have split cycle heating and cooling systems. The 5th bedroom (accessed externally) also has its own split cycle heating and cooling system.

LAUNDRY AREA:
A washer and dryer are available to use, as well as an iron and ironing board.

PARKING:
The double garage is available to use. Our guests have the entire house to themselves, which includes off-street parking for 3-4 cars.

BBQ:
We don't advertise our property having BBQ however, when you arrive, you will see that we have BBQ and may be excited to use it. Please don't. :) It's non-operational at the moment as it needs restoration.

Guest access
Check-in details will be sent two days before your arrival. Access codes will be provided 4 hours before check-in to keep your booking secure.

Only 1 guest key set is provided. Please take care not to lose the keys as their replacement will incur a fee. Losing the key set or leaving it inside the apartment will incur a minimum of $355 charge.

Other things to note
Gardeners attend the house on a regular schedule. Guests booking the house acknowledge they may attend during their stay. There is no internal access required, just external maintenance works.

Any violation of our no-party rule will result in a $2000 non-negotiable penalty, in addition to any damages.

Please do not flush wet wipes, paper towels, or sanitary products. These cause blockages in the sewer system. Dispose in the bin provided.
